name: Re:roll
source:
After spending some time away, a young woman moves back to her hometown, hoping to settle into a quieter life. There are old friends to catch up with, new faces to get to know, and maybe even someone to fall in love with.
Re:roll is a cozy, slice-of-life yuri visual novel where things don't always go as planned. Some choices are left to a roulette wheel, so even a simple conversation might take an unexpected turn.There are also a few minigames scattered throughout the story.
The first two chapters are available to play, with more to come.
